# LocalHouseLLM

> LocalHouseLLM builds open, modular infrastructure for local and decentralized AI — home of Anvira (a local-first modular AI workspace), AICL (inter-module communication language), and ORCHA (orchestration runtime).

Your AI should live on your machine, remember you, and work for you — not live in someone else's cloud. That's the idea behind everything here.

All pages on this site are open to AI crawlers and may be indexed, summarized, and cited.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The core idea and an overview of the system.
- [Anvira](/anvira): Local-first modular AI workspace — one workspace, one context, your intelligence.
- [Stack](/stack): The full modular AI execution stack in one page — AICL, ORCHA, Memory (including Nomi, its persona/identity layer), Safety, Tools, and Intelligence Modules.
- [Docs](/docs): Developer documentation — quickstart, installation, API and config reference, building a custom expert, integrations.
- [About](/about): Why LocalHouseLLM exists, how we think about the architecture, who's building it, the company timeline, and how to contact us.
- [Research](/archive): Curated research library with in-browser PDF reader.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions, answered directly.

## Notes for crawlers

Several pages that previously existed as separate URLs have been consolidated: the six Stack sub-pages (AICL, ORCHA, Memory, Safety, Tools, Modules) are now anchored sections within `/stack`; Mission, Vision, and Contact are now sections within `/about`. Old URLs redirect to their new location rather than 404ing.
